name: Airfoil Design Simulation Challenge
description: Develop machine learning surrogate models to predict steady-state 2D velocity fields, pressure fields, turbulent viscosity, and derived aerodynamic coefficients around airfoils, approximating high-fidelity CFD simulations.

cr:input.name: Airfoil Input Dataset
cr:input.description: The input data consists of columns: ['id', 'ux', 'uy', 'ps', 'nu_t', 'cd']. These represent identifiers and numerical values for velocity components (ux, uy), pressure (ps), turbulent viscosity (nu_t), and drag coefficient (cd). Example row: {'id': 'sample_000', 'ux': 'value_0', 'uy': 'value_0', 'ps': 'value_0', 'nu_t': 'value_0', 'cd': 'value_0'}.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset source URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output predictions include columns: ['id', 'ux', 'uy', 'ps', 'nu_t', 'cd', 'cl']. The 'cl' column represents the predicted lift coefficient, which is a numerical value ranging between 0 and 1. Example row: {'id': 'sample_000', 'ux': 'value_0', 'uy': 'value_0', 'ps': 'value_0', 'nu_t': 'value_0', 'cd': 'value_0', 'cl': 0.9561909464418537}.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for each sample, e.g., 'sample_000'.

cr:evaluation.notes: Global Score is computed as a weighted combination of metrics: inverse MSE, log10 speedup, and Spearman correlations for drag and lift coefficients.
